questions.prompt: Why does the session entry vanish from the shelf when unloadLog() runs?
options: get() checks whether the owner is still loaded
provide() was an effect on memoryLog's context, so its disposer deleted the entry
The greeter plugin deletes services it has used
The root context clears the shelf every time any plugin unloads
questions.explanation: provide wraps the set in effect(), and the returned disposer deletes the name. That disposer runs when the providing plugin unloads.

questions.prompt: Two plugins both call ctx.provide('session', ...). What happens?
options: The second value silently replaces the first
Both values are stored in a list under that name
The first value wins and the second call is ignored
The second call throws because the name is already taken
questions.explanation: provide refuses a name that is already on the shelf, so a clash is reported instead of one plugin quietly overwriting another.

questions.prompt: You mount greeter before memoryLog. What does greeter see?
options: get('session') returns undefined, so nothing is appended
The kernel waits for memoryLog automatically
The kernel reorders the plugins by name
An error, because get() throws for missing names
questions.explanation: get only looks at the shelf as it is right now. Nothing has provided session yet, so the lookup returns undefined.
